overview.name: Button
overview.description: Triggers an immediate user action and communicates its emphasis, context, and availability.
useWhen: The user needs to submit, confirm, create, delete, or otherwise trigger an immediate action.
The interface needs a clearly prioritized action with a visible interaction state.
The control starts or advances an onboarding flow, wizard, or other workflow without navigating to a destination.
avoidWhen: The interaction navigates to a route, URL, file, or other destination; use Link. Canary does not currently provide an approved button-styled Link pattern.
The action cannot be described with a concise label or an icon with an accessible name.

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.description: Interactive container that owns variant, theme, size, shape, and state styling.

anatomy.name: Label or icon
anatomy.description: Primary content that communicates the action; icon-only Buttons retain only the first IconV2 child.

anatomy.name: Leading icon
anatomy.description: Optional IconV2 before the text label.

anatomy.name: Trailing icon
anatomy.description: Optional IconV2 after the text label.

anatomy.name: Loading indicator
anatomy.description: Spinner icon shown while the explicit loading prop or an asynchronous onClick result is pending.

anatomy.name: Tooltip
anatomy.description: Context wrapper supported by tooltipProps and required by the TypeScript API for icon-only use unless explicitly bypassed.

shared.name: variant
shared.description: Sets the visual emphasis and treatment. The link value creates a link-style action but does not provide navigation semantics. The support matrix defines its allowed size, content, shape, and theme combinations.

shared.name: size
shared.description: Sets the component dimensions. Button supports md, sm, and xs; 2xs and 3xs are unsupported.

shared.name: theme
shared.description: Sets the semantic color context. Success and danger apply only to primary, secondary, outline, and ghost text Buttons; all other supported combinations use default.

shared.name: rounded
shared.description: Rounded icon-only Buttons are supported in md, sm, and xs. Rounded text Buttons are deprecated and retained temporarily for migration.
shared.when: Supported when iconOnly is true; deprecated when iconOnly is false.

shared.name: disabled
shared.description: Prevents activation and applies the disabled state.

shared.name: iconOnly
shared.description: Renders only the first IconV2 child and requires an accessible name and tooltip unless the explicit tooltip override is justified.

shared.name: children
shared.description: Provides the visible action label and optional IconV2 children.

designOnly.name: leadingIcon
designOnly.description: Shows the nested leading icon instance.
designOnly.mapsTo: An IconV2 child before the text label

designOnly.name: trailingIcon
designOnly.description: Shows the nested trailing icon instance.
designOnly.mapsTo: An IconV2 child after the text label

designOnly.name: tooltip
designOnly.description: Previews whether an icon-only Button includes its required tooltip composition. Figma does not author production tooltip content.
designOnly.mapsTo: ButtonProps.tooltipProps when true; ButtonProps.ignoreIconOnlyTooltip when false

designOnly.name: previewState
designOnly.description: Selects an interaction-state preview in Figma; only loading maps to a public code prop. Keyboard focus is intentionally excluded because it is a code-only runtime state documented through a detached Figma reference specification.

codeOnly.name: loading
codeOnly.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button while true.

codeOnly.name: onClick
codeOnly.description: Runs the action; a returned Promise automatically activates loading until it settles.

codeOnly.name: asChild
codeOnly.description: Merges Button behavior and styling into its child through Radix Slot.

codeOnly.name: tooltipProps
codeOnly.description: Wraps the button in Tooltip and supplies title, content, side, align, or controlled open state.

codeOnly.name: ignoreIconOnlyTooltip
codeOnly.description: Explicitly bypasses the TypeScript requirement for icon-only tooltipProps.

codeOnly.name: className
codeOnly.description: Adds consumer classes after the contract-governed Button classes.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting state with the selected variant, theme, size, and shape.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer-hover feedback without changing the action meaning.

states.name: focus
states.description: Intentional code-only runtime state activated by :focus-visible. It applies the semantic 2px brand focus outline, a 2px inset gray.25 contrast ring, a -2px outline offset for non-link variants, and a raised stacking context so adjacent controls do not cover the indicator. Figma documents one detached representative reference rather than publishing a focus variant.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable state that prevents native button activation.

states.name: loading
states.description: Pending state that shows a spinner, preserves non-icon-only content, and disables activation.

behavior.description: Invokes onClick once for an enabled activation.
If onClick returns a Promise, enter loading immediately and leave it after the Promise settles.
Explicit or Promise-derived loading disables the rendered button and sets data-loading.
iconOnly retains only the first IconV2 child and applies the cn-button-icon-only class.
asChild replaces the native button element with Radix Slot while retaining Button styling and handlers.

requirements: Every Button has an accessible name; visible text is preferred and icon-only use requires an equivalent programmatic name.
Keyboard focus remains visible for every supported variant, theme, and size through :focus-visible; pointer focus does not force the indicator.
Use the default type=button unless submit or reset behavior is intentional.
Disabled and loading states prevent repeat activation and remain programmatically determinable.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate success, danger, disabled, or loading meaning.

supportMatrix.description: Primary, secondary, outline, and ghost text Buttons support every theme at md and sm.
AI and transparent text Buttons use only the default theme at md and sm.
The link visual variant is supported only for default-theme text actions at md and sm; it does not provide navigation semantics.
Primary, secondary, outline, and ghost text Buttons support every theme at xs.
AI and transparent text Buttons use only the default theme at xs.
Standard icon-only Buttons are supported at md, sm, and xs with the default theme.
Rounded icon-only Buttons are supported at md, sm, and xs with the default theme.
Rounded text Buttons remain temporarily available only for migration.
supportMatrix.migration: Use the equivalent standard-shape Button while preserving variant, theme, size, accessible name, and behavior.

supportMatrix.description: AI and transparent text Buttons do not support success or danger themes.
The link visual variant does not support success or danger themes.
The link visual variant is not supported at xs.
Icon-only Buttons use only the default theme.
The link visual variant is not supported for icon-only Buttons.

bindings.transform: Remove the Figma emoji prefix and map to default, success, or danger. Map the '-' option on md and sm Text sets to an omitted code prop.
Select the matching md, sm, or xs code value.
Map IconOnlyRounded sets to rounded=true and iconOnly=true. TextRounded sets are deprecated and remain mapped only for migration.
Render the selected IconV2 before the label when enabled.
Render the selected IconV2 after the label when enabled.
Map loading to true; default, hover, and active are design previews rather than public code props.

rules.rule: Use one of the contract-owned cn-button-primary, secondary, outline, ai, ghost, link, or transparent treatments.
Use the Button size API and corresponding cn-button size classes instead of local height, padding, or typography overrides.
Use success or danger only with primary, secondary, outline, or ghost text Buttons. AI, transparent, link, and every icon-only Button use default.
Use the standard shape for text Buttons. Use rounded only for supported icon-only Buttons in md, sm, or xs; local border-radius overrides are unsupported.

Use the code-owned :focus-visible treatment: --cn-focus for the 2px brand outline, a 2px inset gray.25 contrast ring, and the cn-tight -2px outline offset for non-link variants. Do not recreate focus with a new Button variant.

do: Use primary for the single highest-priority action in a local context.
Use concise verb-led labels that make the result of activation predictable.
Use Button for action collections and toolbars, including controls that schedule, group, stop, or otherwise change a resource.
Use Button when a control such as Get Started begins or advances an onboarding flow in place.
Use loading for pending actions and allow Promise-returning onClick handlers to manage it automatically.
Use IconV2 children for contract-compatible icon composition.
dont: Use Button as a visual container for non-interactive content.
Use Button, its link variant, or asChild for ordinary navigation; use Link for destinations.
Recreate a button-styled Link locally; propose the pattern to the design system if a destination requires primary Button prominence.
Use iconOnly without an accessible name and a clear explanation of the action.
Use success or danger themes on AI, transparent, link, or icon-only Buttons.
Use rounded on a text Button; migrate deprecated TextRounded Buttons to the equivalent standard-shape Button.
Add local color, size, padding, typography, or radius overrides that recreate an unsupported variant.
Use disabled styling as the only explanation for why an action is unavailable.

patterns.description: Button manages pending feedback for asynchronous actions.
patterns.rule: Return the action Promise from onClick or control loading explicitly; do not create a second local spinner state.

patterns.description: A compact action represented by a single icon.
patterns.rule: Use iconOnly with one IconV2 child and provide an accessible name; tooltipProps is required unless the explicit override is justified.

patterns.description: Rounded is a supported shape for icon-only Buttons and deprecated for text Buttons.
patterns.rule: Use rounded only with iconOnly in md, sm, or xs. Replace rounded text Buttons with the equivalent standard-shape Button while preserving variant, theme, size, accessible name, and behavior.

patterns.description: Button performs actions; Link navigates to destinations.
patterns.rule: Use Button when activation changes state, submits data, opens an interface, or begins or advances a workflow in place. Use Link for routes, URLs, files, and other destinations. The Button link variant changes appearance only, and asChild does not create an approved navigation exception.

patterns.description: Figma documents keyboard focus with one detached representative Button rather than a published component variant.
patterns.rule: Use an enabled md primary default-theme text Button as the representative reference. Apply the 2px border.brand focus outline, 2px inset gray.25 contrast ring, and -2px offset used by non-link code variants; preserve the Button's normal radius and content. Label the example Focus specification. Do not add focus to the published Figma state property or Code Connect mappings.
